python3 -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import parse

# Test FixedTzOffset creation and usage
tz = parse.FixedTzOffset(60, '+01:00')
print(f'tz._offset: {tz._offset}')
print(f'tz._name: {tz._name}')
print(f'tz.tzname(None): {tz.tzname(None)}')
print(f'tz.utcoffset(None): {tz.utcoffset(None)}')

# Try different formats
for offset_val, name in [(0, 'UTC'), (60, '+0100'), (60, '+01:00'), (-300, '-05:00')]:
    tz = parse.FixedTzOffset(offset_val, name)
    print(f'FixedTzOffset({offset_val}, {name!r}) -> _name={tz._name!r}, _offset={tz._offset}')
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
